summary: End-to-end verification of Sertex Süper Yönetici / Kurucu (owner) role hierarchy across BACKEND (pytest 12/12), WEB (serkan super + acme_admin scoping), and MOBILE (Expo web preview: serkan super + acme_admin scoping). Owner protection, super-only endpoints, company scoping, admin caps (can_view_company_tasks / can_create_company / extra_company_ids), and temp super promote/revoke by owner are all working. Non-owner temp super correctly BLOCKED from promoting others. Web and mobile parity verified for Super Admin panel and scoped Settings visibility.

critical_code_review_comments: test_super_admin_hierarchy.py + new test_super_admin_extended.py together give 12 passing tests. Consider merging or splitting file boundaries as the hierarchy feature grows; both files are <200 lines so still healthy.
GET /api/admin/super-admins returns {"super_admins": [...]} envelope rather than a raw list. Fine, but keep envelope stable — several test agents assumed raw list on first pass.

test_credentials: serkan / 19071987 (KURUCU + super_admin), acme_admin / acme12345 (admin @ ACME-RBAC-TEST) — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest ephemerally creates RBACTEST-<sfx> + RBACX-A/B-<sfx> companies and rbac_admin_<sfx> / rbac_emp_<sfx> / rbacx_empB_<sfx> users. All test USERS are hard-deleted in the fixture teardown (mode=hard). Test COMPANIES remain (matches long-standing pattern in repo — see other passing test files like test_multi_company.py). No production data touched. acme_admin was NEVER promoted to temp super; only isolated test admins were promoted+revoked inside the pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Süper Yönetici / Kurucu hierarchy fully verified iter124. Key testIDs on web: super-admin-panel, admins-caps-list, promote-super-<id>, revoke-super-<id>, cap-view-tasks-<id>, cap-create-company-<id>. Key testIDs on mobile: settings-nav-super-admins, super-admins-screen, super-promote-<id>, super-cap-view-tasks-<id>. Single-session caveat is real: don't run serkan on web + mobile simultaneously — always use localStorage.clear() before switching users on web, and logout-button on mobile. For pytest, run with `-o addopts=""` to disable the xdist default from pytest.ini (was causing bogus 'no scheme' errors before env was picked up).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification pass, no new bugs found.
